label: Contradiction-9
title: K-009: Did any technical detail leak on 20 October?
description: Probably different meanings of 'technical detail'. A screenshot of a tool banner and a demonstration video show that an exploit exists, not how it works; the Foundation may mean that no root cause or code leaked. The Hacker News's 'proof-of-concept exploit leaked' is stronger than anything else in the vault carries, and no capture shows a leaked PoC. Open until the Foundation or Daubois says what the Foundation meant.

comments.author: cli-user
comments.text: Run-3: explained by time: the Foundation describes the IDs circulating at about 15:00 UTC on 20 October (The Register: "At that point"); the exploit video came that evening (Feross, Daubois). No capture shows leaked exploit code.
